outcome: Give Banking teams a working AI Credit Scoring for Thin-File & Unbanked Customers capability on their own data — it expands the addressable lending market by ~20-30% without raising the risk bar.
overview: Across MEA, bureau files cover only part of the population, so banks decline creditworthy applicants simply because there is nothing to score. AI Credit Scoring for Thin-File & Unbanked Customers builds ensemble models on alternative signals — telco, utility, transaction and cash-flow data — and returns a decision in minutes rather than days, with feature-importance exposed so credit risk and governance can see why. Risk appetite is unchanged: the models widen who can be assessed, not who is approved without assessment. Four to five weeks on the bank's own data proves whether approval rates move against a measured baseline before any lending policy changes.
